channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'India's opportunities in sports unlimited': PM Modi to young athletes at Sansad Khel Mahotsav
item.description: The Sansad Khel Mahotsav 2025 is a nationwide grassroots sports initiative being organised across every Lok Sabha constituency in the country. Inspired by Prime Minister Modi's Fit India and Khelo India visions, the programme aims to identify and nurture local sporting talent while promoting fitness, discipline and teamwork among the youth.

item.title: Why India's growth still feels incomplete
item.description: As India approaches 2026–27, it faces a paradox of strong macroeconomic performance alongside widespread economic unease. While growth projections, public investment, inflation control and external stability appear robust, most citizens do not experience growth as steady income gains, secure employment or rising dignity. This gap is structural, not perceptual: India has mastered output growth but failed to translate it into broad-based prosperity.

item.title: Janhvi Kapoor slams lynching of Dipu Chandra Das in Bangladesh; hailed as 'actor with spine'
item.description: Janhvi Kapoor spoke out against the killing of a Hindu worker in Bangladesh, identified as Dipu Chandra Das, who was allegedly beaten to death, tied to a tree, and set on fire. The 28-year-old actress shared a detailed note on her Instagram Stories, condemning the attack and calling it barbaric and an act of slaughter.

item.title: 'Epic downfall': Kartik Aaryan recreates Salman Khan's Saajanji Ghar Aaye in Tu Meri Main Tera; fans furious
item.description: Several videos of Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday dancing to Saajanji Ghar Aaye in Tu Meri Main Tera, Main Tera Tu Meri have surfaced on social media. Netizens are angry with the makers and have voiced their opinions online, stating that after ruining Saath Samundar Paar, they have now ruined Saajanji Ghar Aaye as well.

item.title: Akshay Kumar sports two different looks in Welcome To The Jungle trailer; fans unhappy
item.description: The Welcome series began in 2007 with Akshay Kumar and Katrina Kaif in the lead roles, alongside Anil Kapoor, Nana Patekar, Mallika Sherawat and Paresh Rawal. Welcome Back, released in 2015, featured John Abraham and Shruti Haasan as the leads.

item.title: How Bollywood celebrated Christmas 2025: Inside Janhvi, Khushi Kapoor, Gaurav Khanna, Rashmika's celebrations
item.description: Bollywood celebs offered fans a peek into cozy moments. From Ranbir Kapoor's low-key presence at a family bash to Sonakshi Sinha's romantic celebrations and Janhvi–Khushi Kapoor's personal Christmas décor.

item.title: Minimum temperature rises above zero in J&K's Srinagar; cold wave grips Gulmarg, Pahalgam
item.description: The Meteorological (MeT) Department officials said, "Seasonal precipitation (October 1- December 25) remained -44 per cent (Kashmir Division) departure from normal, which is a deficit and -9 per cent (Jammu Division), which is normal. A spell of light snow (higher reaches) and light rain at scattered to many places of J&K during December 31 to January 1 and improvement thereafter."

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade flat amid consolidation phase
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex edged down 83 points, or 0.09 per cent to 85,325 and Nifty eased 17 points, or 0.06 per cent to 26,124.

item.title: Tension in Rajasthan's Chomu after stones pelted at police over mosque railing issue; cops injured
item.description: According to police officials, at least six policemen were injured in the violence and have been admitted to a nearby hospital. Most of the injured personnel sustained head injuries, though their condition is reported to be stable. Several police vehicles were also damaged during the stone-pelting.

item.title: ​US targets alleged manipulation in H-1B system under new rule
item.description: These new rules outline a range of practices that the DHS said raised red flags during recent filing cycles, including wage manipulation, inconsistent job information, and the filing of multiple registrations tied to related entities.
